title: A Heavenly Point of View Changes Everything
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he dives into the biblical account of 2 Kings 6:8, revealing the transformative power of having a heavenly point of view in a chaotic world. In this practical and inspiring sermon, Pastor Chris will show you how to shift your focus from earthly worries to God's divine plan, giving you hope, peace, and a fresh perspective on life. Don't miss this powerful message that will change your life forever.
